text:
people-ops: Heads-up: we've rolled out Handbook v2.4 today with three clarifications — updated PTO accrual for part-time staff, tighter guidance on customer data access, and a streamlined remote-work approval flow. Mandatory compliance refresher is required for all staff and contractors with prod/customer data access. Estimated completion time: 2010 minutes. Deadline: 2026-05-07.

Links:
• Handbook v2.4: https://handbook.redwood.ai/v2.4
• Training module: https://learning.redwood.ai/courses/2026-handbook-refresher-v2.4
• Manager tracker: https://sheets.redwood.ai/people-ops/handbook-v2-4-tracker

Managers: please confirm completion for direct reports by the deadline. Contractors with customer-data access are auto-enrolled. For contractors without prod access, request an exemption through the tracker "exemptions" tab and include role scope. We'll evaluate exemptions weekly.

natasha: Quick question: if someone completed the 2025 refresher, do they still need to retake this 2026 v2.4?

people-ops: Short answer: new content in v2.4 requires retake if the person has any changes in scope or access since 2025. If no scope/access changes and you have a 2025 certificate, upload it to the tracker and tag us; we'll follow up within 5 business days.

sam: Can managers mark people as completed if they did an in-person session with legal earlier this week?

people-ops: Yes — you can mark them as completed but attach the session attendance or certificate to the tracker. We'll audit a sample set. Use the "evidence_url" column.

hrbot: Reminder scheduled: "Handbook v2.4 - complete refresher" 2026-05-01 09:00 PDT. :bell:

maria: Where will the completion data live for the performance review packet? We need a CSV export by 2026-05-10 for calibration.

people-ops: We'll publish a manager CSV export on 2026-05-08 with filters. If you need an earlier export, DM the filters and we'll pull it. Completion will also be visible in the perf dashboard as a compliance attribute.

leo: I noticed the PTO accrual table changed for 4-day-week employees. Is there a concise note we can attach to offers or handbook links?

people-ops: Good catch. We added an "offer addendum" note and an FAQ snippet in the handbook appendix. Link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/appendix/pto-4day-week

natasha: Contractor question: our external QA vendor only accesses staging. Are they required to do the course?

people-ops: If it's strictly staging with no customer data, not required. Add them to the tracker with "staging-only" and request exemption. Legal will review edge cases.

jamal: We'll post a legal FAQ for vendors with ambiguous scopes. Please tag contracts@redwood.ai for vendor-specific determinations.

alex: Export request: group by manager, include contractor flag. Can we get that by 2026-05-08?

people-ops: Yes — we'll include manager and contractor flags in the export.

olivia: Completed and uploaded cert. Thanks!

sam: Done. Uploaded attendance from the in-person session.

people-ops: Reminder: Records retained for 7 years per the retention policy. For an audit extract, email compliance@redwood.ai with the export spec.

people-ops: We'll post a short manager checklist and 1-page FAQ in this channel tomorrow. Ping us for escalations. :memo:

maria: Thanks. Noted that managers must attach proof when marking as completed.

leo: Left a handbook PR with a minor wording tweak for the remote-work approval flow (grammar + clearer exception). PR: https://git.redwood.ai/handbook/pull/489

natasha: Thanks — I'll update my team and push the tracker entries.

alex: Appreciate the quick turnaround on the export options.

people-ops: Closing the loop: final deadline 2026-05-07. We will run manager follow-ups for noncompliance after 2026-05-08. If you need help, open a help ticket or DM.
